_comment: R2 lifecycle rules for the ASSETS bucket (docs/deployment.md 'Backups and retention'). A backstop behind the worker's retention job: apply with `aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --endpoint-url $R2_ENDPOINT --bucket $R2_BUCKET_ASSETS --lifecycle-configuration file://infra/r2/lifecycle.json` after removing this _comment key. The RENDERS bucket (finished videos) has no expiry rule.
